title: Setup under zh-CN still draws English on Audit Log (title, presets, filters, columns, "Open as list"), Datasources (title) and System Overview (KPI subtitles Users / Sessions / Events); Feature Flags title reads "功能开关Beta"
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**. Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What is seen (`@objectstack/console` 18.1.0, browser locale zh-CN, every other Setup page translated)

| page | English strings |
|---|---|
| 诊断 → 审计日志 (`component/audit/log`) | title "Audit Log", subtitle "Read-only system activity and record changes. Newest first.", button "Open as list", "Presets", filter labels Action / Object / Actor / From / To, placeholders "All actions" / "Any object" / "Any user", column headers Timestamp / Action / Object / Record / Actor / IP, actor "System" — [t33-审计日志.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/t33-审计日志.png) |
| 集成 → 数据源 (`component/metadata/resource?type=datasource`) | title "Datasources" — [t36-数据源.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/t36-数据源.png) |
| 总览 → 系统概览 | KPI subtitles "Users", "Sessions", "Events" under translated titles — [t00-系统概览.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/t00-系统概览.png) |
| 配置 → 功能开关 | page title renders as one word 「功能开关Beta」: the Beta badge has no gap from the title — [t29-功能开关.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/t29-功能开关.png) |

`reach:` the public UI, each measured once as the dev admin; the same strings in the English bundle are, of course, fine.

## Expected

Bundle keys for the audit log component, the datasource admin page title and the system-overview KPI subtitles (the KPI subtitles may be the dashboard's `subtitle` strings in `@objectstack/setup`, in which case that half is an objectstack card; triage decides from the component source). A space or badge margin on the Feature Flags title.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "Setup audit log page untranslated English title columns in Chinese locale" → 6 hits (#13405, objectstack-ai/objectui#12924, objectstack-ai/objectui#12762, objectstack-ai/objectui#12333, objectstack-ai/objectui#10835, objectstack-ai/objectui#10748), all closed and none covering the audit log, datasources or system overview. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §7 S2, S7.
